```sql
SELECT player_id,
       player_name,
       SUM(ast) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(turnover), 0) AS ast_to_tov_ratio,
       SUM(CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_played
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY ast_to_tov_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
```
